The '''Verpine asteroid director''' was an unusual utility vehicle from [[SlaynRoche Co.]] It was a 10-meter-long [[energy conversion thruster]] which vaporized dross from mining by means of controlled fusion reaction, creating thrust, moving asteroids (such as into place for mining or out of shipping lanes). A single director could move an asteroid massing up to 50 metric tons; larger asteroids were moved by remotely linked directors placed at intervals. The directors were sometimes used to arrange asteroids into "natural" defense networks or to "drop" asteroids on [[Deflector shield/Legends|unshielded]] worlds. A unit cost 12,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was operated by a single pilot.
